Title: Getting ready to do some custom (Anarch) tokens

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
As discussed at EC with some people we're getting ready to produce Anarch counters (could be used for VTES or perhaps in some other games...). The size is roughly the same as European 1 cent and 2-3 mm thick.

Material is transparent acrylic, although the bottom is completely covered in opaque printing. The one with background cut off shouldn't have anything in the bottom.

Estimated pricing is around 5 euros for 10.

Here are a couple of pictures of the three possible choices for the production model. Which one do you think should be chosen?

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Hahaha, based on the comments here, at both FB's VTES World and local group it seems that all counters are getting votes.

My own least favorite one (black background and red A) seems to be getting way most votes and the one I liked the most (the cut out one) seems to be getting least votes. Heh, whatever version we decide to use, there will be people saying that we picked the wrong one

Well, the minimum order is 1000 counters, which makes 100 ten counter sets so I'd imagine that this amount should sell in not that long a time. And we could use one of the other designs for the following restock...
